problem.title: Hot Potato Game
problem.problemStatement: There are N players standing in a circle, numbered from 1 to N. Starting from player 1, a token is passed clockwise exactly K times. The player holding the token after the K-th pass is eliminated. The process continues with the next player until only one player remains. Return the number of the winning player.
